context_requirements: Intact phosphoinositide signaling and inositol lipid turnover
Cellular dependence on inositol recycling for PIP2/PIP3-dependent signaling
Presence of TSPO if the drug acts through TSPO rather than IMPA1
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of inositol phosphate, phosphoinositide, or lithium-like transcriptional signatures after treatment
Consistent upregulation of immediate-early genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1, or ATF3 at 6 h
Dose-dependent viability or stress responses at 10 micromolar across multiple lines
